senses.gloss:
युञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्)
 1. Uniting, Joining.
 2. Uniting spiritually,
practising devotion.
 E. युज् to join, &c., शतृ aff.

युञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Uniting, combining, joining with.
 m. (-नः)
 1. A
charioteer.
 2. A Brāhmana engaged in the religious exercise called
Yoga.
 E. युज् to join, &c., aff. शानच् and नुम् inserted.
